title: Periodicity forcing for the patterns a^i b a^j b a^k b a^l: Holub's WORDS 2025 problem
description: Proof that XXYYXYX=UUVVUVU forces X=U, Y=V or all four words commute (Lean-checked); complete classification of periodicity forcing for all 625 tuples with exponents at most four; the family (i,0,k,l) settled through exponent six via a certified Fine-Wilf cone covering with an independent checker. Manuscript, Lean files and certificates.
